text_en: Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old; he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.
text_cn: 希则克雅登极时年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王凡二十九年；他的母亲名叫阿彼雅，是则加黎雅的女儿。

text_en: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord , just as his ancestor David had done.
text_cn: 希则克雅行了上主视为正义的事，完全像他祖先达味所行的一样。

text_en: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the Lord and repaired them.
text_cn: 他作王元年正月，开了上主殿宇的门，再加以修理；

text_en: He brought in the priests and the Levites and assembled them in the square on the east.
text_cn: 召司祭和肋未人来，聚集在东面广场上，

text_en: He said to them, “Listen to me, Levites! Sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of the Lord , the God of your ancestors, and carry out the filth from the holy place.
text_cn: 对他们说：“肋未人，请听我的话！现在你们应自洁，好清除上主你们祖先的天主的殿宇，将圣所内的污秽之物除去。

text_en: For our ancestors have been unfaithful and have done what was evil in the sight of the Lord our God; they have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the dwelling of the Lord , and turned their backs.
text_cn: 因为我们的祖先犯了罪，行了上主我们的天主视为不悦的事，离弃了他，并转脸不顾上主的居所，以背相向；

text_en: They also shut the doors of the vestibule and put out the lamps, and have not offered incense or made burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.
text_cn: 又封闭了廊门，熄灭了灯，未在圣所内给以色列的天主焚香，献全燔祭。

text_en: Therefore the wrath of the Lord came upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he has made them an object of horror, of astonishment, and of hissing, as you see with your own eyes.
text_cn: 因此，上主的盛怒降于犹大和耶路撒冷，使之成为恐惧、惊骇、耻笑的对象，正如你们亲眼所见的。

text_en: Our fathers have fallen by the sword and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
text_cn: 并且我们的祖先因此死于刀下，我们的妻子儿女作了俘虏。

text_en: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the Lord , the God of Israel, so that his fierce anger may turn away from us.
text_cn: 现在，我有意与上主以色列的天主立约，使他的烈怒转离我们。

text_en: My sons, do not now be negligent, for the Lord has chosen you to stand in his presence to minister to him, and to be his ministers and make offerings to him. ”
text_cn: 我的孩子们！现在不要再怠慢，因为上主拣选了你们侍立在他面前，为奉事他，向他焚香。”

text_en: Then the Levites arose, Mahath son of Amasai, and Joel son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish son of Abdi, and Azariah son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah son of Zimmah, and Eden son of Joah;
text_cn: 于是肋未人起来：刻哈特族中有阿玛赛的儿子玛哈特和阿匝黎雅的儿子约厄耳；默辣黎族中有阿贝狄的儿子克士和雅肋肋耳的儿子阿匝黎雅；革尔雄族中有齐玛的儿子约阿黑和约阿黑的儿子厄登；

text_en: and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeuel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;
text_cn: 厄里匝番子孙中有史默黎和耶乌耳；阿撒夫子孙中有则加黎雅和玛塔尼雅；

text_en: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
text_cn: 赫曼子孙中有耶希耳和史米；耶杜通子孙中有舍玛雅和乌齐耳，

text_en: They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in as the king had commanded, by the words of the Lord , to cleanse the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 他们集合自己的弟兄，先行自洁，后照君王的吩咐，根据上主的命令，来清除上主的殿。

text_en: The priests went into the inner part of the house of the Lord to cleanse it, and they brought out all the unclean things that they found in the temple of the Lord into the court of the house of the Lord ; and the Levites took them and carried them out to the Wadi Kidron.
text_cn: 司祭进入上主殿宇里面去清除，将上主殿内所有的污秽之物，移到上主殿宇的院内；肋未人接过来，运到城外的克德龙溪。

text_en: They began to sanctify on the first day of the first month, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the vestibule of the Lord ; then for eight days they sanctified the house of the Lord , and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.
text_cn: 他们在正月一日开始清除，第八天清除到上主的殿。正月十六日清除完毕。

text_en: Then they went inside to King Hezekiah and said, “We have cleansed all the house of the Lord , the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the table for the rows of bread and all its utensils.
text_cn: 于是他们去见希则克雅说：“我们已经将上主的殿宇、全燔祭坛，以及坛上所有的器具、供饼桌，以及桌上所有的用具，全部清洁了；

text_en: All the utensils that King Ahaz repudiated during his reign when he was faithless, we have made ready and sanctified; see, they are in front of the altar of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 并且连阿哈次王在位犯罪时，所丢弃的器具，我们都整理好，也都清洁了；现在都放在上主祭坛前面。”

text_en: Then King Hezekiah rose early, assembled the officials of the city, and went up to the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 希则克雅清晨起来，召集城内的首领，上到上主殿内。

text_en: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats for a sin offering for the kingdom and for the sanctuary and for Judah. He commanded the priests the descendants of Aaron to offer them on the altar of the Lord .
text_cn: 人们带来了七只牛犊，七只公绵羊和七只羔羊；此外，还有七只公山羊，为国家，为圣殿，为犹大作为赎罪祭；王遂吩咐亚郎的子孙司祭奉献在上主的祭坛上。

text_en: So they slaughtered the bulls, and the priests received the blood and dashed it against the altar; they slaughtered the rams and their blood was dashed against the altar; they also slaughtered the lambs and their blood was dashed against the altar.
text_cn: 祭杀了牛犊，司祭将血取来，洒在祭坛上；祭杀了绵羊，将血洒在祭坛上；祭杀了羔羊，也将血洒在祭坛上。

text_en: Then the male goats for the sin offering were brought to the king and the assembly; they laid their hands on them,
text_cn: 最后，将献作赎罪祭的公山羊，牵到君王和会众面前，他们将手按在公山羊身上，

text_en: and the priests slaughtered them and made a sin offering with their blood at the altar, to make atonement for all Israel. For the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.
text_cn: 司祭宰杀了，将血献在祭坛上，作为赎罪祭，为以色列民众赎罪，因为君王曾吩咐过：全燔祭和赎罪祭，应为以色列民众奉献。

text_en: He stationed the Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals, harps, and lyres, according to the commandment of David and of Gad the king’s seer and of the prophet Nathan, for the commandment was from the Lord through his prophets.
text_cn: 王又派定肋未人用钹、瑟和琴，在上主殿内奏乐，有如达味王的先见者加得和先知纳堂所吩咐的，亦即上主藉先知所吩咐的。

text_en: The Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
text_cn: 于是肋未人拿着达味的乐器，司祭拿着号筒，一起站着。

text_en: Then Hezekiah commanded that the burnt offering be offered on the altar. When the burnt offering began, the song to the Lord began also, and the trumpets, accompanied by the instruments of King David of Israel.
text_cn: 希则克雅遂下令在祭坛上献全燔祭。全燔祭开始时，颂扬上主的歌声和号声，也在以色列王达味的乐器伴奏下，随之开始。

text_en: The whole assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded; all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
text_cn: 同时全会众跪拜，唱歌的唱歌，吹号的吹号，这样直到全燔祭献完为止。

text_en: When the offering was finished, the king and all who were present with him bowed down and worshiped.
text_cn: 献完了祭，君王和所有同他在场的人，都屈膝跪拜。

text_en: King Hezekiah and the officials commanded the Levites to sing praises to the Lord with the words of David and of the seer Asaph. They sang praises with gladness, and they bowed down and worshiped.
text_cn: 此后，希则克雅王和众首领，又吩咐肋未人用达味和先见者阿撒夫的诗词，赞颂上主。他们便欢乐地赞颂了上主，随即俯首朝拜。

text_en: Then Hezekiah said, “You have now consecrated yourselves to the Lord ; come near, bring sacrifices and thank offerings to the house of the Lord . ” The assembly brought sacrifices and thank offerings; and all who were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.
text_cn: 希则克雅又吩咐说：“你们既然奉献了自己与上主，请近前来，将感恩祭祭物，送入上主殿内。”会众便将感恩祭祭物，以及甘心献的全燔祭献上。

text_en: The number of the burnt offerings that the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs; all these were for a burnt offering to the Lord .
text_cn: 会众所献的全燔祭牺牲总数为：牛犊七十只，公山羊一百只，羔羊二百只，全献给上主作全燔祭。

text_en: The consecrated offerings were six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep.
text_cn: 还有祝圣的牲畜：牛犊六百只，羊三千只。

text_en: But the priests were too few and could not skin all the burnt offerings, so, until other priests had sanctified themselves, their kindred, the Levites, helped them until the work was finished—for the Levites were more conscientious than the priests in sanctifying themselves.
text_cn: 由于司祭太少，不能剥尽全燔祭牺牲的皮，所以他们的弟兄肋未人前来协助，直到工作作完，直到司祭自洁完毕，因为肋未人自洁的诚心胜过司祭。

text_en: Besides the great number of burnt offerings there was the fat of the offerings of well-being, and there were the drink offerings for the burnt offerings. Thus the service of the house of the Lord was restored.
text_cn: 此外，还有许多全燔祭、和平祭、脂油，及与全燔祭同奠的酒，等待处理。这样，上主殿内的礼仪就全恢复了。

text_en: And Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of what God had done for the people; for the thing had come about suddenly.
text_cn: 希则克雅和全民众都很快乐，因为天主为人民准备，使此事迅速完成。
